name: session.location.translateAddress
title: Profile: session.location.translateAddress
description: Canonical MCP pattern for normalizing or language-targeting an address into structured location data.
text:
# Session location translateAddress

TL;DR:
- Use this profile when the user gives a free-form address and you want a normalized structured result in a chosen language.
- Supply the address text and the target output language.
- The result can be used for display, verification, or later geo-aware workflows.
whenToUse: The user provides a full or partial address and wants it normalized.
You need the same address expressed in a specific output language.
recommended: Use the target presentation language for lang.
Show address to the user as the normalized preview.
Check confidence before assuming the first result is definitely correct.
avoid: Do not describe the result as exact unless the confidence and components make sense.
Do not use this profile when a stable stored location id is already known.
exampleInterpretation: Treat address as the normalized user-facing representation.
Treat country, city, street, zip, lat, and lon as structured components.
Use the result for later map or geo search flows if needed.
